scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and independently constructed numerical corroboration; simulations are not infinite-time proofs. Scientific comparisons and their residual priority limitations are recorded in AUDIT.json.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional, stationary, two-state asymmetric run-and-tumble with positive harmonic confinement, thermal diffusivity and Poisson rates. Path observable is active-force work, not every version of total entropy production. No full large-deviation theorem or finite-time law. Priority against all possible broader work theorems is not certified.
title: Exact active-work fluctuation law and a sharp anisotropy window for confined run-and-tumble motion
